title: Ambient-Pressure Layered Borocarbide Candidate
statement: Propose a novel charge-neutral, dynamically plausible layered borocarbide CIF targeting Tc > 40 K at 0 GPa.
context: Target MgB2-like sigma-bonding bands near the Fermi level with light-element phonon modes.

title: Low-Pressure Ternary Clathrate Hydride (< 20 GPa)
statement: Propose a novel ternary clathrate hydride CIF stabilized by chemical pre-compression below 20 GPa.
context: Screen ternary metal-boron-hydrogen or metal-carbon-hydrogen stoichiometries absent from Materials Project.

title: T1 MACE-MP-0 Relaxation & Convex Hull Batch #1
statement: Relax queued T0 CIF candidates using pinned MACE-MP-0 weights and compute E_hull against the pinned Materials Project hull snapshot.
context: Tolerance: energy within 2 meV/atom, lattice parameters within 0.5%.

title: T3 Quantum ESPRESSO DFPT Phonon + EPW Verification
statement: Run pinned SSSP Quantum ESPRESSO relaxation, DFPT phonon dispersion (zero imaginary modes > 0.1 THz), and isotropic Eliashberg Tc.
context: Known-good canaries: MgB2 (~39 K at 0 GPa) and H3S (~200 K at 150 GPa).
